senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. חָתַת)to dig, break in, make an opening.
units: <cite ref="Kiddushin 24b">Kidd. 24ᵇ</cite> <he>חֲתוֹר לי שיני</he> Ar. (ed. <he>לַחְתּוֹר לו שינו</he>) scrape my tooth (to clean it).

<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 2:20">Deut. R. s. 2</cite> (ref. to <he>וַיֵּעָתֶר</he>, <cite ref="II Chronicles 33:13">II Chr. XXXIII, 13</cite>) <he>וַיֶּחְתַּר לו וכ׳</he> the Lord made an opening for his prayer; <he>ח׳ את הרקיע</he> He broke through the heavens; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 10:2:14">Y. Snh. X, 28ᶜ</cite> bot.; <cite ref="Ruth Rabbah 5:6">Ruth R. to II, 14</cite> <he>ח׳ לו חתירה וכ׳</he> (v.

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 37">Ex. R. s. 37</cite> <he>נטל את הצפורן לַחְתּוֹר וכ׳</he> (Ar. s. v. <cite ref="R00687"><he>צפורן</he></cite>: <he>לחפור</he>) he took the digging tool to undermine his father’s house; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 10">Lev. R. s. 10</cite> (<he>לחתך</he>, <he>אחתוך</he>, <he>לחתוך את אביו</he>) (corr. acc.).

Gen. R. s. 63 (ref. to וַיֶּעְתַּר, Gen. XXV, 21, v. supra) like a prince שהיה חוֹתֵר על אביו ליטול וכ׳ who undertook a siege (for military practice) against his father for a litra of gold (for the winner) והיה זה ח׳ מבפנים וכ׳ and so the one did mine from within &c. (the father assisting his son’s efforts).—

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 109a:14">Snh. 109ᵃ</cite> <he>וחוֹתְרִים שם</he> and broke in there; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 27:3">Gen. R. s. 27</cite>; a. fr.—Part. pass. <he>חָתוּר</he>, f. <cite ref="H00034"><he>חֲתוּרָה</he></cite>, pl. <he>חֲתוּרִים</he>, <he>חֲתוּרוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 114b:31">B. Kam. 114ᵇ</cite> <he>היתה מחתרת ח׳ וכ׳</he> his house was broken into.

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 23a">Ib. 23ᵃ</cite> <he>סתם דלתות ח׳ הן וכ׳</he> with reference to dogs, ordinary doors are subject to being broken in, i.e. the owner of a dog is responsible for damages done by breaking in.
